title: The king toss (Hikaru Nakamura vs Gukesh, 2025)
post: He threw the world champion's king into the crowd 👑😳 #chess #hikaru #gukesh #story

voice._name: Callum (ElevenLabs premade), eleven_v3 with audio tags in "say"

phrases.text: He checkmated the world champion, then threw his king into the crowd.
phrases.say: [mischievously] He checkmated the world champion, then threw his king into the crowd.

phrases.text: Wait till you see how the champion answered.
phrases.say: [curious] Wait till you see... how the champion answered.

phrases.text: This is Hikaru Nakamura, world number two.
phrases.say: This is Hikaru Nakamura... world number two.

phrases.text: October 2025. A stadium in Texas. USA versus India, and resigning is banned.
phrases.say: October twenty twenty-five. A stadium in Texas. USA versus India... and resigning is banned.

phrases.text: USA wins four straight. Last match: Hikaru versus Gukesh, the world champion.
phrases.say: USA wins four straight. Last match... Hikaru versus Gukesh. The world champion.

phrases.text: Ten minutes: draw. Five minutes: draw. Then bullet.
phrases.say: Ten minutes... draw. Five minutes... draw. [excited] Then... bullet.

phrases.text: Gukesh is winning. He can repeat moves for a draw.
phrases.say: Gukesh is winning. He can repeat moves... for a draw.

phrases.text: Instead, he walks into mate in one.
phrases.say: [whispers] Instead... he walks into mate in one.

phrases.text: Hikaru grabs the king, and throws it into the crowd.
phrases.say: [excited] Hikaru grabs the king... and throws it into the crowd!

phrases.text: But it was planned. GothamChess said the winner was supposed to throw the king.
phrases.say: [mischievously] But... it was planned. GothamChess said the winner was supposed to throw the king.

phrases.text: Hikaru said: "If I won, I was always gonna throw the king."
phrases.say: Hikaru said... 'If I won, I was always gonna throw the king.'

phrases.text: Three weeks later, Saint Louis. Same two players. This time, Gukesh wins.
phrases.say: Three weeks later. Saint Louis. Same two players... This time, Gukesh wins.

phrases.text: No throw. No celebration. He just puts every piece back.
phrases.say: [softly] No throw. No celebration. He just puts every piece... back.

phrases.text: So, one to ten: how disrespectful was that throw?
phrases.say: [curious] So... one to ten. How disrespectful was that throw?
